from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class RegionStart(BaseModel):
    """Housing start volume for a single region in a single month."""
    region: Literal["Northeast", "Midwest", "South", "West"] = Field(description="Name of the region")
    starts: float = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate of housing starts for this region")

class MonthlyHousingRecord(BaseModel):
    """Housing start data for a specific month from a specific report."""
    data_month: str = Field(description="Month of the data in YYYY-MM format")
    release_date: str = Field(description="Release date of the report in YYYY-MM format")
    national_starts: float = Field(description="National total seasonally adjusted annual rate of housing starts")
    regions: list[RegionStart] = Field(description="Breakdown by region")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    monthly_records: list[MonthlyHousingRecord] = Field(description="Monthly housing start records extracted from the document")
